evidence: Executed the contestability audit and reproduced four capabilities, two mandates, one admissible mandate, 4/4 contracts, 3/4 tested exits, 4/4 exception routes, 4/4 reviews, artifact-store blocked and gate=fail.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The identity mandate passes all six predicates; artifact-store fails only exit readiness, so the overall mandate gate correctly fails.

evidence: Verified mandate implication and the conjunction of obligation, benefit, stable contract, tested exit, equitable exception and independent governance.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The model correctly applies mandatory predicates only to mandates while retaining distributional assessment outside a misleading scalar aggregate.

evidence: Traced outcome-boundary, proportionality, separation, contestability, portability and measurement invariants through standards, paved roads, mandates, abstractions, extensions, exceptions, appeals, funding and retirement.
invariant_checking.notes: The invariants prevent scope overreach, convenience mandates, self-judging providers, paper appeals, untested lock-in and captive-adoption success claims.

evidence: Verified two platforms with identical 100% adoption: one is voluntarily retained with tested alternatives; the other blocks export and exceptions while transferring toil.
proof_review.notes: Equal adoption with unequal outcomes and contestability correctly refutes complete adoption as sufficient evidence of beneficial standardization.

evidence: The complete-adoption counterexample is explicitly labeled as a proof sketch and states both the refuted claim and stronger evidence required.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No governance design, concentration vector, mandate predicate, open standard or exception target is represented as a universal theorem.

evidence: The contestability gate is explicitly synthetic and disclaims universal standards/timing; examples are scenarios; sources are retrieval-dated; no real mandate or organization outcome is claimed.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Normative governance mechanisms, illustrative execution, current external guidance and hypothetical cases remain distinct from empirical claims.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified required order, one-page review, definitions and formulas, twelve-step mechanism, six invariants, bounded proof sketch, executable audit, eighteen trade-offs, thirty misconceptions, ten examples, ten connections, fifteen references, and five answered exercises.
